# Used when building with --build-arg MODE=packages.

# CRAN names are pinned by the SNAPSHOT date in the Dockerfile.
# GitHub entries are owner/repo, optionally owner/repo@ref where ref is a tag,
# branch, or commit SHA.

tidyverse
data.table

# ---- GitHub (DARTH) ---------------------------------------------------------

# commit that was actually installed is recorded in /opt/r-sbx-manifest.txt —
# check there before citing a result. Append @<sha> to freeze one.

DARTH-git/darthtools
janitor
